extraction_warnings: Detailed demographic data (exact age, sex ratio) are referenced only in Additional file 1: Table S1, which was not provided in the extracted text, so those fields are marked not_reported or low-confidence inferred.
No individual sample/subject identifiers or NCBI accession numbers were found in the provided text.
Sequencing platform model (e.g., HiSeq/MiSeq) not explicitly specified; only 'Illumina platform' mentioned.

Granularity classified as subgroup_level because study reports distinct control/pHTN/HTN cohorts with subgroup-specific case/control roles and conditions, though most demographic details are only at study level.
Batch 1 subgroups ['control', 'pre-hypertension (pHTN)', 'hypertension (HTN)'] differ from batch 0 ['control', 'pHTN', 'HTN']; kept batch 0.

Numeric age and BMI values are referenced as covariates analyzed for correlation with microbiota abundance but exact values are only in supplementary Table S1, which was not provided in the given text.

fmt_role and related donor information pertain to a small subset (n=3) of human FMT donors, which does not align with the main three-group (control/pHTN/HTN) subgroup structure used for most other fields; treated as a separate note rather than a full subgroup breakdown.
Smoker and antibiotics_current_use fields were inferred from exclusion criteria rather than directly stated participant-level status.
Several schema fields (ECOG performance status, tumor size, disease response OS) are not applicable to this hypertension/gut-microbiome study and were marked not_reported.

The study involves both human participants and germ-free mice (for fecal microbiota transplantation); host_species was extracted as 'human' reflecting the primary clinical cohort, but mouse data are also present and could be considered a secondary host species not captured by a single-value field.

biomarker_value/unit/name fields were populated using BP classification thresholds (SBP/DBP) rather than individual biomarker measurement values, since no other biomarkers (FBG, TC, TG, LDL) had explicit units or values reported in the main text.
feces_phenotype_value field does not have a clear corresponding measurement in this paper; interpreted as not_reported.
